answer.text: The standard warranty lasts 36 months or 30,000 km, whichever comes first, from the date of sale to the first owner.
The warranty carries over to each later owner for the balance of the remaining warranty period.
A second or later owner should tell the nearest Royal Enfield Service Centre about the purchase and fill in the form it asks for to use the warranty.
The emission-control warranty also applies after a change of ownership, provided its conditions are met from the date of original sale.
Parts of the evaporative emission control system have a different period, 24 months from the date of first use, so confirm the period with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

policy.text: The warranty applies only if all maintenance and services are done within the warranty period and the kilometre ranges in the schedule, at a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer or Service Centre.
